**No — not yet from the chat UI directly. Honest answer with the two gaps:**

The worker itself is **proven working** — task `903fd413` just autonomously walked the full pipeline to VERIFIED with all 4 evidence fields and 3-way SHA parity (`af3799de1ad7` GitHub=Render=Runtime). But two things are still missing for the "go to IVX IA chat → type a request → get real senior dev work end-to-end" flow:

1. **Chat intent router is NOT wired.** Typing a senior-dev request in IVX IA chat currently hits the chat brain, not the worker API. The worker only accepts jobs via direct `POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs` with field `goal`. I have not connected the chat intent router (`backend/services/ivx-chat-intent-router.ts`) to forward senior-dev requests to the worker endpoint.

2. **`requestsDeploy:true` tasks still get stuck after approval.** Path B self-deploy-recovery code was reverted during root-cause isolation (it was NOT the build-breaker — `public-chat.ts` was — but I reverted it to isolate). Without Path B, the approve handler sets status=COMMITTING but the worker's `claimTask` only picks QUEUED/RETRYING → task hangs. Tasks with `requestsDeploy:false` (like `903fd413`) work end-to-end but don't self-deploy — deployId has to be captured manually.

**To make it YES, I need to do two things:**
- Wire `ivx-chat-intent-router.ts` to route senior-dev intents → `POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs` (so chat messages reach the worker)
- Re-apply Path B code (7 files at `2055e2da`) on top of the fixed HEAD so `requestsDeploy:true` tasks survive self-deploy restart and capture deployId autonomously

Want me to do both now? The first one is the blocker for "go to chat and get real senior dev work." The second is needed if you want the worker to also deploy its own commits without me triggering it manually.
